reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: Remote work has fundamentally transformed urban landscapes in recent years. With more employees working from home, cities have experienced decreased demand for commercial office space, leading to the conversion of downtown buildings into residential apartments and mixed-use developments. This shift has reduced traffic congestion and pollution in major metropolitan areas. However, it has also impacted local businesses that depended on office workers for daily revenue, such as restaurants and retail shops. Urban planners are now adapting city infrastructure to accommodate this new reality, focusing on creating vibrant neighborhoods that attract residents beyond traditional business districts.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one consequence of increased remote work in cities?
questions.explanation: 원문에서 'This shift has reduced traffic congestion and pollution in major metropolitan areas'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 원격 근무로 인해 교통 혼잡이 감소했다는 것이 정답입니다.

questions.q: What has happened to downtown buildings due to remote work?
options: They are converted into residential and mixed-use developments
They have increased in commercial value
questions.explanation: 'conversion of downtown buildings into residential apartments and mixed-use developments'라는 문구에서 도심 건물들이 주거용과 복합용도 건물로 전환되었음을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: Which businesses have been negatively affected by remote work according to the passage?
questions.explanation: 원문의 'local businesses that depended on office workers for daily revenue, such as restaurants and retail shops'에서 음식점과 소매점이 부정적 영향을 받았다고 언급되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work is better for employees than working in an office environment.' Provide specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (agree/disagree)과 함께 2-3개의 주요 이유를 미리 제시하기
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유 상세 설명 - 구체적인 예시나 증거 포함 (예: 시간 절약, 생산성 향상, 유연성)
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유 상세 설명 - 반대 관점도 간단히 인정 후 본인의 입장 강화
structure.conclusion: 앞서 언급한 주요 포인트를 요약하고 전체적인 입장을 재확인하기

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work offers several advantages...
Although some argue that..., I believe...
In conclusion, the benefits of remote work outweigh the drawbacks because...
For example, studies have shown that...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in a traditional office environment. Others prefer to work remotely from home. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons for your preference.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer remote work because...
One reason is that remote work allows me to...
Additionally, I find that working from home helps me...
sample_points: 유연성과 시간 절약 - 출퇴근 시간 제거로 더 많은 개인 시간 확보 가능, 가족과의 시간 증가, 자신의 페이스대로 업무 수행
생산성 및 집중력 향상 - 조용한 환경에서 방해 없이 일할 수 있음, 중요한 회의와 소통은 온라인 도구로 효율적 진행 가능, 스트레스 감소

listening.title: Career Counseling Session
listening.script: Student: I'm not sure if I should accept the job offer. It's a great position, but it requires me to relocate to another city. Counselor: That's a significant decision. What are your concerns about moving? Student: Well, I'd have to leave my family and friends behind. Also, the cost of living there is much higher. Counselor: Those are valid concerns. However, have you considered the career growth opportunities? This company is well-known for developing young talent. Student: That's true. I've heard great things about their training programs. Counselor: Also, many young professionals find that relocating helps them develop independence and build new networks. Plus, you can always visit home during holidays. Student: I hadn't thought about it that way. Maybe the benefits do outweigh the drawbacks. Counselor: Take your time deciding, but remember that career growth is important at your stage.

questions.q: What is the main reason the student is hesitant about the job offer?
options: It requires relocating away from family and friends
questions.explanation: 학생은 'It requires me to relocate to another city'라고 했으며, '가족과 친구들을 떠나야 한다'는 점을 주요 우려사항으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: According to the counselor, what is an advantage of relocating for this job?
options: Better weather in the new city
Career growth opportunities and developing independence
More time to spend with family
questions.explanation: 상담사는 'This company is well-known for developing young talent'과 'relocating helps them develop independence and build new networks'라고 강조했습니다.

questions.q: What is the counselor's overall recommendation?
options: Take time to decide but remember career growth is important
Ask for a remote work option
questions.explanation: 상담사는 'Take your time deciding, but remember that career growth is important at your stage'라고 말했으며, 학생이 충분히 고려한 후 결정하도록 조언했습니다.
